metadata.source: DARPA TC Ground Truth Report E3 Update, Section 3.13
metadata.description: The Nginx backdoor downloads several payloads. Elevation of /tmp/main fails; XIM runs as root, while /tmp/test executes without root and performs the micro-APT communication and scan branch.
metadata.selection_rule: Select one observable for every distinct payload instance described in the episode: compromised nginx communication, both minions/XIM executions, the attempted main execution, every test execution, and the terminal C2 observations. Ground Truth event labels are not used to rank candidates.
